notes: Published values are provisional CUSTOMER PRICES only; private cost/pricing margins belong to the owner-controlled calculator.
All 20 model-size totals are rounded to the nearest whole ruble as a final step; Quadro 5.5 m uses 506741 rubles.
Kvadro's protruding centered entrance and Viking's centered arched entrance are included in their updated base customer prices; do not bill separately.
The Kvadro 5 m featured set includes 50 mm insulation on 10.5 m²; mandatory frame floor belongs to the base.
Minor socket work and internal wiring were removed from customer-configurable paid add-ons: ordinary wiring is already part of the base.
The electrical safety cabinet is designated as mandatory base equipment by the owner, but model, scope and factory cost remain a RELEASE GATE.
The exact default stove model and price must be confirmed with the producer; upgrades should replace—not duplicate—the base stove.
Normal product base and the feature bundle remain PRELIMINARY until the electrical shield specification and economics are approved.
Terrace, delivery, unloading, site foundation, site electrical hookups and on-site assembly are not included without a separate confirmed contract.
